title: Floor Jack Identification
text: Help me ID this floor jack. Overhaul kit for the Hein-Werner HW93652 was purchased, but only the main piston seals fit. Any clue which make/model this is? No identification on it.
triage_reason: Auto repair mechanic needs help identifying an unbranded floor jack to source correct seals.

title: I’m just hemorrhaging money-failing leaf season..
text: This will be the start to my 3rd leaf removal season, I can’t loose money this year like the others…I need help from folks that know what to do… Key Info: I’ve got good equipment and decently set up enough customers for what seems to be a decent customer log/load I can deal with 80% of my customers I can dump curb side and or “in the back 40”. if I remove leaf bags when I’m done I have a few places I can deposit them, usually whichever dump set up I’m closest to, for free... I’m just hemorrhaging money-failing leaf season..
triage_reason: Landscaping business owner is losing money during leaf removal season and needs operational help.
